OFFICIAL BALLOT WARD 1, P1&2 ALL SPLITS
BALLOT STYLE 1
STATE OF MISSISSIPPI
LEE COUNTY
CITY OF TUPELO
2025 GENERAL ELECTION
TUESDAY, JUNE 3, 2025

INSTRUCTIONS TO VOTER: Fill in the oval to the left of the name of your choice. You must
blacken the oval completely using a dark pen, and do not make
any marks outside of oval. Do not use a red pen, felt tip pen, or
any type of pencil.
DO NOT CROSS OUT - If you change your mind, exchange
your ballot for a new one. If you tear, soil, deface or erroneously
mark this ballot, return it and obtain another.
END OF BALLOT
